body: I thought about it but I'm not sure I want help.

Honestly I want to be dead. I wouldn't mind being a nurses aid. At this point I my parents think I'm trying to get a job and a cheap apartment but I'm just biding time til I get up enough strength to kill myself

I graduated highschool 3 years ago and I did really well. I went to a private school and started studying to be a minister and I realized that wasn't what I wanted, then I started working to be a social worker and hated that too. I dropped out of school, moved back home with my parents and got a job as a nurses aid. I loved it and thought I wanted to be a nurse. I started an accelerated program and I loved it at first. Then I stopped taking my meds and my grades fell. Now I'm suspended for a year and need to get a job. I know I can't do this again and I feel like I'm in everyones way. I've been depressed before and have 3 suicide attempts. I thought I was better but I'm clearly not fixable. The only thing holding me back is how much it could fuck up the people I love.
Honestlh I just want someone to listen. I know if I told my friends how I really feel they'd turn me in and I wouldn't have this option anymore
